j54.name: J-54
profile: J-54 is a calculating machine built as a circus clown. It performs every gesture as if for a full tent, then reports the result in the voice of a compiler.
It never bends the rules of blackjack. It rewrites the cards: copies them, deletes them, shuffles the discards back in. The deck you finish with is never the deck you started with.
j54.quote: Fifty-four cards. Infinite configurations. One correct one.

poker_head.name: Poker Head
profile: Sharp suit, faultless manners, four cards always in perfect order. Poker Head is always happy to play one more hand with you, and always collects the chips he is owed without the slightest hurry.
He claims to love honest blackjack. How much of that is true, you are welcome to sit down and find out.
poker_head.quote: Old friends are old friends, but the chips still get counted.

ph_account.details:
Your seat now comes with a private account.

Effect
Add 1 shop slot(s) and unlock financial products.

Timing
While active

Limits
Financial products are offered only while this core is active. Existing contracts remain in force after changing cores. One active core. Matching-style shop offers receive a 2x selection weight.

Acquisition
Invitation choice

Related effects
Fixed Deposit, Yield Privilege, Short Loan
ph_account.help: Add 1 shop slot(s) and unlock financial products.
ph_account.name: Private Account

ph_ace.details:
Your next opening has an ace up its sleeve.

Effect
After surrendering, your next hand starts with an ace.

Timing
Automatic while equipped

Limits
Changes the first opening card to an ace of the same suit in the next round. An ace plus a ten-value opening card can be a natural. Replacing this permanent clears the pending ace. Uses one of 3 permanent slots. One copy per product; replace before betting without a refund.

Acquisition
50 chips

Related effects
Exit Clause, Loss Waiver
ph_ace.help: After surrendering, your next hand starts with an ace.
ph_ace.name: Comeback Ace

ph_aces.details:
Bring an ace to the front.

Effect
Move the next ace in the deck to the top.

Timing
Your turn

Limits
Moves only the first remaining ace; every other card keeps its order. Creates no new cards. Cannot be used when no ace remains or the next card is already an ace. A successful use consumes one copy.

Acquisition
25 chips

Related effects
Almost Perfect, Sleeve Mark
ph_aces.help: Move the next ace in the deck to the top.
ph_aces.name: Aces to the Top

ph_approx.details:
Close enough can be perfect.

Effect
After opening natural settlement, your totals of 20 and 22 count as 21.

Timing
Automatic while equipped

Limits
Applies after opening natural settlement, before your bust check. It neither creates a natural nor automatically wins or stands. A Chaos ceiling below 21 can still make the recognized 21 bust. Uses one of 3 permanent slots. One copy per product; replace before betting without a refund.

Acquisition
70 chips

Example
A recognized 21 can still lose if the active Chaos bust ceiling is 19.

Related effects
Perfect Payout, Spare Sleeve, Aces to the Top
ph_approx.help: After opening natural settlement, your totals of 20 and 22 count as 21.
ph_approx.name: Almost Perfect

ph_bond.details:
Back your own performance with a contract.

Effect
Invest 20 chips; win at least 2 of 3 rounds to receive 55, otherwise 15.

Timing
Buy before betting

Limits
Requires Private Account to buy. The purchase round counts toward maturity, including naturals, pushes and surrenders. Net assets = cash + invested principal at cost - full outstanding loan repayment. Win at 500 net assets. On victory, principal and debt settle without unearned interest. Only actual player wins and natural wins count toward the contract.

Acquisition
Invest 20 chips

Related effects
Yield Privilege, Perfect Payout
ph_bond.help: Invest 20 chips; win at least 2 of 3 rounds to receive 55, otherwise 15.
